source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch adds widget.macos.native-anchored-menus=false only under XP_MACOSX and removes explicit native=false settings throughout owned markup, runtime builders and fixtures. Accepted source retains that platform default, while a distinct accent-color popup still has an explicit flag. The unified-toolbar caller and test concern popup pressed state rather than native rendering. Keep the platform default, specific target removal and runtime result separate; comm source alone does not establish the paired engine's preference behavior or equivalence for every menu.
title: The macOS menu default replaces many explicit per-element native opt-outs
